audit.why: Levels 1-3 to Jayce on pure range, level 6 back to him on the item/tornado swing, and Yasuo owning everything from two items — that matches a 50.56% matchup over 1697 games and Yasuo's crit scaling against a Jayce with no defensive stats.
Spikes are placed at 1-3, 6 (Last Breath, 70s at rank 1), first item and 2+ items, and each names the mechanic that causes the shift rather than the level alone.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page repeatedly says Windwall 'blocks the poke' and to bait it, but never says what Windwall does NOT block — which is most of Jayce's kit — and never gives the wall a cooldown.
audit.why: Riot kit: Wind Wall is 25/23/21/19/17s and blocks projectiles. Of Jayce's tools only Shock Blast is a projectile; To the Skies! is a targeted leap, Thundering Blow is a targeted knockback and Lightning Field is a self-centred zone. So a Yasuo standing behind his own wall is standing in front of your entire hammer form, and he has to live with that choice for up to 25 seconds.
audit.corrected: State the 25s/17s wall cooldown and that hammer form ignores it entirely.

edits.before: Once his Windwall and first item are up the poke war evens out. He can eat one full accelerated orb on the Windwall cooldown, so bait it with a cheap cannon-Q before you fire the real one. At 6 respect the tornado: if his third Steel Tempest is charged, a stray minion knockup into Last Breath ends you, so never commit a Hammer Q-E-W combo into a live Windwall-or-knockup window. Keep Thundering Blow ready to knock him out of his dash when he over-commits.
edits.after: Once his Windwall and first item are up the poke war evens out. The wall is 25 seconds at rank 1, 17 maxed, and it eats one accelerated orb � but Shock Blast is the only thing you own that it stops. So when the wall goes up, swap to Hammer and walk in: To the Skies!, Thundering Blow and Lightning Field all land through it. At 6 respect the tornado � if his third Steel Tempest is charged, a stray minion knockup into Last Breath ends you.

edits.before: Blocks your cannon Q. Bait it, then hammer-poke. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Wind Wall is 25s at rank 1, 17s maxed. It stops Shock Blast, never hammer form.

edits.before: - Yasuo Wind Wall: matchup-defining — Blocks your cannon Q. Bait it, then hammer-poke. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Wind Wall: 25s at rank 1, 17s maxed — it eats Shock Blast and nothing else, so walk in behind it in hammer form. - Steel Tempest: 4s, and the third cast is the knockup his ultimate needs. - Last Breath: 70s at rank 1.

edits.before: Track Yasuo's Wind Wall: Blocks your cannon Q. Bait it, then hammer-poke. When it is down — Cannon-Q + hammer him.
edits.after: Wind Wall blocks Shock Blast but not To the Skies!, Thundering Blow or Lightning Field — swap to hammer and walk in.
